resources.string: Sign in to send files and messages straight to your other devices, end-to-end encrypted.
Relayium could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Your session has ended. Sign in again to use the Device Inbox.
This device could not read or write its Inbox records.
This device’s Inbox history has reached its storage limit. More history cannot be saved right now.
This device cannot repair its Inbox key right now. Its secure storage is unavailable.
The server selected an Inbox protocol this version of Relayium cannot use. Update the app.
The server sent a response Relayium could not accept.
This device accepts nothing. Your other devices are told it is not receiving, so they will not offer to send to it.
Deliveries wait until you accept them here.
Deliveries from your own devices are accepted and saved automatically.
Receiving is on, but this device cannot write to its received folder.
The received folder is blocked by something else with the same name.
There is no room left to save a delivery.
Relayium is not allowed to write to its received folder.
Relayium receives while the app is open, whichever screen you are on. It does not deliver in the background.
This device holds the key your other devices encrypt to.
Your account publishes an Inbox key this device does not hold, so it cannot open anything sent to it.
This device\'s stored Inbox keys cannot be read. They may come back if secure storage is restored.
The key this device recorded does not match the one your account publishes.
Your account publishes more than one active Inbox key for this device. Relayium will not guess which one is meant; remove this device\'s Inbox from another device and set it up again.
This device\'s secure storage cannot hold a new key, so the repair would leave it unable to receive. Nothing was changed.
A new key will be published for this device. Anything already queued to the old key stays encrypted to it and cannot be opened here. Your existing files and messages are not affected.
No other device on this account has a Device Inbox yet.
Relayium cannot use this device\'s identifier.
This device has no Device Inbox. Open Relayium there once.
This device\'s Inbox was revoked. Set it up again there.
The server says this device cannot receive right now.
This device runs a version Relayium cannot send to. Update it.
This device has not published a usable encryption key.
Receiving is switched off on this device.
Someone has to accept it there.
That device last reported it cannot save files.
That device is offline. The delivery will wait.
This device cannot show messages, so only files can be sent to it.
Ready to send. Nothing has been sent yet.
Delivered to your account. Waiting for that device to save it.
Relayium cannot tell whether this reached the other device. Trying again is safe: the server keeps only one copy of this delivery.

The upload stopped without an answer, so Relayium cannot tell whether these encrypted bytes reached the server. Sending again would start a separate upload and still would not answer that, so this one cannot safely be retried.
That device cannot receive this right now.
That device changed its key while this was being sent.
The server already holds a different delivery under this one\'s identity.
These encrypted bytes already belong to another delivery.
That device already has as many waiting deliveries as the server will hold.
Relayium could not finish sending. Nothing was lost; try again.
This device could not write what it needs to send. Nothing was sent.
Nothing has been exchanged with your other devices yet.
The text of this message is no longer stored on this device.
This removes the entry from this device\'s history only. It does not cancel anything, does not clear the other device, and does not delete files you have already saved.
A device that has left this account

Received files and messages live inside Relayium on this device. Clearing the app\'s data, or uninstalling it, deletes those copies. They are never included in a cloud backup or a phone-to-phone transfer.
